title: iOS Lead (6-Month Contract)
description:
**About Us:**

ClearRoute is an engineering consultancy bridging Quality Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Developer Experience. We help enterprises reliably bring high-impact digital products to market faster, cheaper, and safer, working with technology leaders facing complex business challenges.

We take as much pride in our people, culture and work-life balance as we do in making better software. We’re not just making better software. We’re making the making of software better. Collaborative, entrepreneurial and dedicated to problem solving, we bring the step change our customer need to sustain innovation. Our values challenge us to do the best we can for ClearRoute, our customers and most importantly our team. This is an opportunity for you to build the organisation from the ground up, use your voice to drive change and help transform organisations and problem domains.

**Role:**

We’re looking for an experienced iOS Lead with 10–14 years of experience to lead a team building native iOS apps on a complex project in the publishing domain. You’ll work directly with the customer and guide the team as tech lead on a codebase that several teams contribute to. The team works in an AI-first way, so you’ll be expected to use AI tools in your daily development and encourage the team to do the same. This is a 6-month contract.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and guide the iOS team as the tech lead
* Engage directly with the customer
* Drive native iOS development on a complex publishing project
* Work with other teams contributing to the same codebase
* Use AI-assisted development tools and encourage the team to use them
* Take a proactive approach to delivery and to supporting the team

**Required Experience:**

* 10–14 years of experience, at senior or lead level
* Strong hands-on experience in native iOS development
* Proven experience as a tech lead, leading and guiding a team
* Experience working with customers
* Experience working on a shared codebase with multiple teams
* Hands-on use of AI and agents
* Proactive and able to take ownership

**Desirable Experience:**

* Experience in the publishing domain
* Working knowledge of LangChain or similar LLM frameworks (e.g., RAG, agents)
* Experience building AI-powered features in iOS apps (e.g., integrating LLM services via REST, Core ML, Apple Intelligence)
* AI-powered features in iOS apps (Core ML, Apple Intelligence…)

**Working at ClearRoute**  
We have grown from six founders to 180+ people across five countries in three years, and what sets us apart isn't the pace, it's how we grow.

* **Real flexibility, in practice.** We trust you to perform at your best and still have a life outside of work, with genuine hybrid working, a home office budget, an open feedback culture where your voice shapes decisions, and time off when life needs it (birthday included).
* **When ClearRoute wins, you win.** We offer profit share so success is shared, meaningful recognition for great work, and benefits that look after you and your family, including private healthcare, competitive salary benchmarking, and a confidential employee assistance program covering counselling, mental health support, and financial wellbeing.
* **A community you'll genuinely want to be part of.** Interest based communities like running and book clubs, Women in Tech group, monthly socials, and cross regional events bring people together across the company. An inclusive, collaborative culture where you don't need to conform to succeed, where people support one another and feel comfortable being themselves.
* **Where meaningful work meets real growth.** You will tackle complex, real world problems at the forefront of platform engineering, AI, security, and scalable systems. Your growth is supported by learning budgets, Udemy access, a clear career framework, internal mobility, and thought leadership opportunities that take your impact beyond ClearRoute.

*At ClearRoute, we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes, and inclusion creates the conditions for everyone to thrive. We are proud to have built a family friendly working environment and have many employees who have caring responsibilities alongside work. We welcome applications from people who require flexibility and will be happy to discuss needs on an individual basis.*

*We are committed to fostering a culture where all team members feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We celebrate individuality and our differences and understand that some differences may mean that you require changes made to the interview process. We are happy to cater to your needs to make the interview accessible, if this is something you require please let us know by emailing us at* *join@clearroute.io*

title: Flutter Developer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and experienced **Flutter Developer** with 3+ years of experience in mobile application development. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of mobile application development, API integration, UI/UX implementation, and experience working with Android and iOS platforms.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Design and implement responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance mobile applications.
* Develop reusable and scalable Flutter widgets and components.
* Integrate **REST APIs, third-party APIs, and backend services**.
* Work with databases and cloud services such as Firebase.
* Implement authentication, notifications, and other mobile application features.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues and performance problems.
* Conduct unit testing, widget testing, and integration testing.
* Ensure applications are optimized for performance, stability, and scalability.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in code reviews and follow coding standards and best practices.
* Publish and maintain applications on **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**.
* Stay updated with the latest Flutter, Dart, and mobile development technologies.

Required Skills

* 3+ years of professional experience in **Flutter application development**.
* Strong proficiency in **Dart and Flutter**.
* Good understanding of **Android and iOS application development**.
* Experience with **RESTful APIs and JSON**.
* Hands-on experience with **Firebase** and its services.
* Good knowledge of state management solutions such as **Provider, BLoC, GetX, or Riverpod**.
* Experience with Git and version control systems.
* Strong understanding of responsive UI development.
* Knowledge of mobile application architecture and design patterns.
* Experience with debugging, performance optimization, and application testing.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Support Executive – Website & App (EdTech)
description:
We are looking for a technically skilled and problem-solving candidate to manage technical queries and resolve issues related to our educational website and mobile application. The candidate will coordinate with developers when required and ensure a smooth digital learning experience for students.

Key Responsibilities

* Resolve technical queries related to the website and mobile application.
* Troubleshoot student login, registration, OTP, password reset, and account access issues.
* Handle problems related to online courses, video lectures, test series, study materials, and course access.
* Investigate payment failures, transaction status, fee confirmation, and course activation issues.
* Identify and report website bugs, app crashes, errors, and performance issues.
* Coordinate with website developers, app developers, and third-party service providers for technical fixes.
* Test website and app functionality after updates or bug fixes.
* Maintain a record of technical complaints, resolutions, and pending issues.
* Guide students and internal teams in using the platform correctly.
* Escalate complex technical problems to the development team and follow up until resolution.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of websites, mobile applications, and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of browsers, internet connectivity, cache, cookies, and app installation.
* Familiarity with Android applications and website testing.
* Basic knowledge of APIs, databases, HTML, CSS, or debugging tools is an advantage.
* Good communication and student-support skills.
* Ability to diagnose problems logically and explain solutions in simple language.

Qualifications

* Graduate or diploma holder in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge may apply; prior technical support experience is preferred.
* Experience in EdTech, LMS platforms, website support, or app support is an advantage.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Digital S/W Engineer Analyst SDE \- Mobile Development is a Technology/ Engineering role involving both development and Testing. As a member of the SCRUM team, you will be
  

delivering Customer facing Banking and/or Credit Card features on digital channels such as Browser and Mobile. You will be involved in all stages of the Agile SDLC cycle. It includes but not
  

limited to (a) Requirement analysis: Grooming of user stories, Story pointing, decomposing big stories into smaller stories and define acceptance criteria. (b) Design Review: Reviewing
  

screens, flows, features, and customer communications (emails, SMS’s, notifications, PDF documents) and making sure that they are consistent with user story acceptance criteria
  

(c) Software development: Developing, configuring and debugging applications comprising of mobile frontend and Micro services. (d) Validations: Creating automated and manual test scripts
  

on BDD (Behavior Based Development) framework, executing test scripts. Identifying, triaging and fixing any defects. Conditioning and maintaining the test data. (e) Artifact
  

Ownership: Creating and maintaining testing artifacts such as Test plans and Exit reports and maintaining traceability as per SDLC guidelines. Maintaining SDLC hygiene involving stories.
  

Test cases and defects. Ensuring that no untested code goes out to production. (f) SDLC Process and Standards: Adhering to ADA (Americans with Disability Act) Guidelines, participating in
  

retrospectives, process improvement workshops, audits and performing root cause analysis. (g) Postproduction support: Supporting the technical check outs during release go live and
  

postproduction activities.


Responsibilities


* Translate application designs into code across Android/Jetpack/Kotlin development platforms as Primary Skill, with guidance from senior developers.
* Deep understanding of the **Android SDK**, platform lifecycle, and Google ecosystem (Jetpack, Android Runtime, etc.)
* Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot to assist with code generation, refactoring, and debugging tasks.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of BDD (Behavior Driven Development) automated and manual test scripts in a code repository; execute scripts and record results in a test management tool.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to help accelerate unit test creation, API scaffolding, Angular components, and Spring Boot boilerplate code.
* Participate in the software development lifecycle including development, integration, and E2E testing within a CI/CD environment (e.g., RTC, Jenkins).
* Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code under the guidance of senior engineers, and take accountability for assigned features.
* Build and maintain documentation for your features and begin developing subject matter expertise in specific areas of the application.
* Assist in analyzing root causes for application issues and performance concerns; collaborate within the scrum team to triage and report defects.
* Learn and adhere to SDLC control processes and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.
* Perform functional validations to meet acceptance criteria; gain familiarity with Responsive Web Design validation and ADA Accessibility testing tools (e.g., NVDA, Voiceover, Talkback, Axe).
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to tracking progress against team objectives.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced environment involving onshore and offshore teams.

Education, Qualification \& Certifications


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or a related STEM field, or comparable work experience.
* 4\- 7 years of experience in full\-stack mobile development and/or testing in a professional environment.
* Basic familiarity with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) concepts; exposure to test automation frameworks such as Selenium with Cucumber is a plus.
* Exposure to or interest in cloud\-based development platforms such as OpenShift is desirable but not required.
* Basic working knowledge of collaboration and project management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Eagerness to learn, self\-motivated, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Good written and oral communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team.
